dict.string: In-cab mode uses your speed to record driving when the vehicle moves and other work when it stops, like a tachograph.
Scan a vehicle's number plate to find it in your list or add it.
In-cab mode checks the iPhone's motion sensor to tell that you're in a moving vehicle, so walking around isn't recorded as driving.
Allow “Always” so in-cab mode keeps recording driving and stops while the app is in the background or the phone is locked.
